name: self-host-real-repository-context
intent: Harden loadGraph and validateGraph context selection with deterministic SearchEngine ranking
captureLimitations: The benchmark captures declared corpus bytes and Git status projections only; it does not claim a complete Repository Snapshot.
The checked-in Knowledge Graph was generated at its declared commit and may be stale relative to the current HEAD.
Static analysis cannot prove runtime-only or dynamic call targets, so the Call Graph boundary remains unknown.
